judge_agent: one general-purpose sub-agent per model, fresh context, tools on, read-only on the repository
prompt: judge/PROMPT.md (<MODEL> replaced by the run folder name)
inputs: judge/inputs/<model>/<figure id>.md, written by scripts/judge_inputs.py from truth/ and runs/; the judge may also open the figure crop, the full truth and the model's full output
isolation: a judge reads one model's outputs only and no other judge's file
output: judge/<model>.json; aggregated by scripts/judge_summary.py into judge/summary.md and metrics/plots/error_types_by_model.png
truth_agent: three general-purpose sub-agents (parts A, B, C), fresh context each, no access to model outputs; prompts in truth/PROMPT-*.md
